exposure: Genital herpes during pregnancy or labour
outcome: Rates of proven cases of neonatal herpes
cohort: Neonates born in The Netherlands between 2006 and 2011, reported by virology laboratories, gynaecology, and paediatrics departments of all hospitals.
finding: The incidence of neonatal herpes in The Netherlands was 4.7 per 100,000 births between 2006-2011 and seems to have increased, with only 59% of gynaecologists and up to 39% of paediatricians reporting policy adherence.
cross-section timing: Retrospective data collection for the period 2006-2011
